'''A7-E3PO''', also known as '''Aysev''', was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that served as a member of the [[Droid Equality Foundation]], a large and powerful [[Droid/Legends|droid]] rights group. A7-E3PO tried to act as a voice of reason within the Foundation and the protocol droid opposed the radical philosophies of the [[CZ-series secretary/comm droid|CZ-series droid]] [[T-215]], which encouraged droids to rebel against their masters. A7-E3PO traveled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], spreading the beliefs of the Droid Rights Foundation as it went, and it often visited courts, corporate headquarters and the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], lobbying on the Foundation's behalf. A7-E3PO was reprogrammed by [[Jolor Oron]], the leader of the Foundation, to exhibit utmost loyalty towards the organization, and it was aware that Oron secretly planned to bring about the destruction of all droids.
